value.rationale: This is a motivated strengthening of the 2026 finite-model filtration from up to exponentially many Boolean atoms to at most the number of distinct subformulas. It additionally preserves the entire algebraic equality pattern of the observed trace via a Boolean homomorphism, with the exact optimal r−1 coordinate bound for general traces. Such a quantitative normal form gives a direct and small representation for constructing semantic witnesses and comparing finite valuations, independently of the already-known coNP complexity implication. The fact is structural and uniformly quantified, not an arbitrary small case or an unmotivated count.
